inputs.text: Five months after a ceasefire was announced, families in Gaza still face airstrikes, gunfire and shelling. Ahmed Baroud, a displaced father of five in Deir al-Balah, says drones buzz overhead and naval fire threatens fishermen. A promise on paper is worthless if families cannot sleep safely or earn a living. Peace requires real security, order and the chance to rebuild—not more slogans while civilians endure fear and displacement.
